Boxes labeled 'Puricas' and 'Mederma' are prominent. A hand enters the frame, pointing at and touching some of the products on the lower yellow shelf. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a woman with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a colorful floral patterned shirt. She stands in a brightly lit retail environment with shopping aisles and promotional posters in the background. She talks to the camera with expressive hand gestures and an engaged facial expression. (3) The shot cuts back to a close-up of her hands holding a small white product box, showing its back label with ingredient information. The camera then returns to her face as she continues her explanation, occasionally glancing down at the product. (4) The video concludes with a static, professional-looking outro screen. The background is white with subtle gray textures, featuring the clinic's logo at the top and detailed contact information, including a phone number, LINE handle, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text.
